title: C2 Selection JSON
description: Development/test record for one actual user-selected final cut. Selling points describe the complete product pool; selected_ids and roles describe only this plan. Opening choice is an AI record, not a machine judgment. Routine SRT execution never calls this JSON schema or Python tools. Create one independent record for each user-selected opening.

verification_mode.description: script means the optional helper was run; manual never claims a machine pass.

selected_ids.description: Source cue IDs for one generated final plan, ordered for playback. Create one selection record per emitted plan.

plan_core.description: The independent, source-supported purchase core that distinguishes this plan from other emitted plans.

estimated_duration_seconds.description: Approximate duration for this completely arranged plan, calculated after arrangement. 120 seconds is not a target or hard cap.

duration_mode.description: Per-plan classification after full arrangement; a slight overrun can retain decision-critical content.

reason.description: For a long-form omission, explain its lower contribution to this plan's core while confirming that the purchase decision remains complete.

omitted_selling_points.description: Any valid pool point omitted by this individual plan after the clearly-over-120-second dynamic preset; disclose these in the final plan. Never use another plan's union to cover an omission.

selling_points.description: The complete valid independent purchase-information pool for this product. Each plan starts from this pool and independently covers all effective points when at or below 120 seconds; over 120 seconds follows the dynamic long-form policy and records valid omissions.

role.description: 适用促单原话必须来自原文；适用于当前商品和成片且符合规则时完整保留，不得编造、改写、补充或跨商品移用。

hard_rule_outcomes.description: AI-recorded hard-rule conclusions for semantic replay comparison; the diff utility reports changes but does not judge them.

opening_choice.description: Optional AI record of a real hook and its immediate bridge, evaluated jointly for attention in the first 2 seconds and continuity through the first 5 seconds. Prefer a dynamically classified, open-ended viewing-motivation hook whenever any qualified candidate exists; fall back to other valid hooks only when none exists. Classify by actual viewing motivation, not product-benefit category or type label. No fixed order, weight, or score within the first priority; multiple plans may share one best hook. At default 1.2x, 2.4 and 6 cumulative source seconds are references only, never hard cuts. This schema is not a workflow dependency.

known_unaccelerated_ms.description: Optional estimate supplement for display only; duration remains approximate and is never used for acceptance, pause, or splitting.
